messages:
maria_sales: Heads-up — AcuNova POC kickoff tomorrow. They want a clear answer on a few procurement/legal items before we start billing: 1) how POC billable credits accrue (do we bill if they exceed trial allotment mid-POC?), 2) a DPA redline — they resurfaced a legacy subprocessor clause that our legal says is unacceptable, 3) KMS/HSM requirement: they asked for customer-managed HSM for keys, and 4) signature routing: they want eSign but one EU subsidiary demands wet-ink fallback. @kevin_legal @tara_procurement @josh_se @leah_security can you advise? :wave:

kevin_legal: quick Qs — can you paste the exact DPA paragraph they sent? if it's the old "legacy subprocessor" language we usually either remove or move to an appendix with stricter controls. If they insist, we'll need exec approval. also need to know if this is an SOW add-on (affects invoicing).

maria_sales: pasted snippet from their counsel:
```
"We reserve the right to engage legacy subprocessor partners with transfer of data outside EU without prior notice unless prior written consent is provided."
```
Not great.

kevin_legal: Yeah that's a hard no as-is. Proposal: 1) replace with: "Vendor will provide notice and reasonable opportunity to object; additional safeguards (SCCs/technical controls) will apply" OR 2) provide an appendix listing named subprocessors and a 30-day notice period. I'll draft both options and flag for approvals. ETA EOD.

tara_procurement: From billing side — we need PO path and net terms. AcuNova prefers Net45 but finance prefers Net30. Also confirm if POC consumption beyond credits will be invoiced as overage or held until a signed orderform. @billing_ops — can you confirm our standard POC credit handling?

billing_ops: Standard policy: we grant X free credits for the POC window; any consumption beyond should be captured as billable overage on the next invoice unless customer signs an orderform committing to reserved capacity. For enterprise POCs we can do a pre-billed credit invoice (customer pays up-front) if requested. For this customer we can accept Net30; Net45 needs revenue signoff. Need customer billing contact to issue PO.

josh_se: On KMS/HSM — tech note: Hosted API (public) does not support customer-managed HSM. Dedicated and Private deployments do (bring-your-own-KMS or HSM via our Private installer). Short-term workaround: we can encrypt payloads client-side or use our managed KMS with strict key scoping, but that may not satisfy procurement/security. If they require HSM proof, we'll need to scope the POC as Dedicated or Private. That changes pricing and lead time (2-3 weeks to provision capacity).

leah_security: Also need them to complete our security questionnaire and provide SOC2 report + any data classification. If they insist on wet-ink for EU sub, what legal justification do they cite? often it's internal policy not legally required. We can accept eSign + audit trail for most, but will escalate if they truly require wet-ink. Link to questionnaire: https://redwood.example.com/sec-qa (please fill out before kickoff).

maria_sales: They said it's a local compliance audit for the EU subsidiary — likely insists on wet-ink for license signature but POC orderform might be OK as eSign. I'll push back and ask for written requirement.

kevin_legal: Good. For signature routing: we can do layered signing — eSign for orderform and a countersigned wet-ink MSA addendum if they absolutely require. But that slows down timelines. Suggest we propose: eSign now to start POC (with limited liability clause for trial), and wet-ink for the final MSA if required. I'll draft language to protect us during eSign phase.

billing_ops: If we do eSign now and they later require wet-ink for the MSA, we should record the eSign as "acknowledgement for POC only" and require a follow-up countersign for production contract. I'll add that note to the invoice terms.

maria_sales: Thanks. Two practical asks: Kevin — can you drop the 2 redline options into the thread (or send as comment) so I can share with their counsel? Josh — can you confirm lead time + cost delta if Dedicated is required for HSM? Billing_ops/Tara — I'll get the billing contact and confirm Net30/Net45 preference. Leah — I'll ping the customer about the security questionnaire link now.

kevin_legal: Will post redlines in thread by 18:00 PST.

josh_se: Dedicated lead time ~10 business days to provision GPUs + KMS binding. Pricing: baseline POC price + Dedicated surcharge; rough delta ~25% depending on capacity. If they accept a limited pilot config (smaller instance), we can shrink lead time to ~5 days.

docsign-bot: Created eSign envelope #ENV-8872 for AcuNova orderform (expires in 14 days). Signers: AcuNova PO contact, Maria (sales). Status: pending.

billing_ops: Follow-up — we can pre-authorize an overage cap on the orderform to avoid surprise billing. Recommend adding a $2k cap for the POC unless they want open overage.

maria_sales: Perfect. I'll propose: 1) eSign orderform with pre-authorized overage cap, 2) start POC on hosted config while we confirm HSM requirement, 3) if they demand HSM we pause and move to Dedicated with new orderform. Sharing Kevin's redlines + questionnaire link with customer now. Will update in this thread. :thumbsup:"
